title: Homerun core schemas
description: Generated from packages/core by scripts/gen.ts. Protocol v1, spec format 1. Do not edit.

ClientMsgId.description: Generated by the sending client; makes messages.send and queued instructions idempotent

MessageId.description: Assistant message id from the SDK; ties deltas to their final message

ModelCheck.description: One cheap query() that returns CheckResult (§8.3)

ModelId.description: A Claude model id or alias. Free-form, because Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry ids differ (§7.2)

Origin.description: The authenticated device that sent something (§9.9), never taken from message content

PairingCode.description: One-time secret shown only in the QR code. Format is not fixed by the design; see README gaps.

RpcId.description: Request id; null is not allowed

RuleCheck.description: Evaluated by the runtime with no model call (§8.3)

RunState.description: pending = queued for a slot; abandoned = given up without an agent outcome

SdkSessionId.description: Claude Agent SDK session id; opaque

SecretName.description: Keychain items the shell holds for the runtime (§11)

Surface.description: Where a message or answer was sent from. Only 'web' has reduced authority (§9.9)

TimestampMs.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC
